decision.rationale: The audited seed-42 public-development mean HR@10 is 0.59675 for the candidate, 0.59525 for the incumbent, and 0.59475 for the generated control. The host marks the candidate eligible under its baseline-only rule, so retain it for host selection. The candidate's +0.00150 gain over the incumbent misses the proposal's >0.005 prediction and its >0.60025 mean target. Movies_and_TV fell by 0.020 versus the incumbent and 0.019 versus the control; the control's -0.00050 aggregate contrast is near null. These outcomes do not establish late local refinement as the cause or show confirmed generalization.
unresolved_explanations: The candidate and control change multiple dilation positions. Optimization and checkpoint selection could explain the small aggregate difference instead of final-block local refinement.

The single seed and differing category effects leave stability unresolved. Exploratory history slices include positive, negative, and null effects; sparse long-history bins cannot establish a history-dependent mechanism.

Host admission and synthetic pre- and post-training checks cover sampled behavior, but do not establish all-input behavior or isolate the proposed mechanism. The author's own CPU checks were unexecuted, and the proposal's full diagnostic set is not separately demonstrated.
No confirmation or final-test result is supplied.
